messages.profile.withAgent: Review profile and conditions with agent
messages.agent.reconcileInstruction: Review the actual activity for this exact case. Clarify uncertainty and record only events supported by my report or evidence. Do not retry or send anything automatically.
messages.agent.rewriteInstruction: Improve the selected saved document. Read its exact version and supporting facts first, preserve meaningful achievements, save a new draft, and do not send anything.
messages.agent.profileInstruction: Review my profile, evidence and track conditions. Ask concise questions for missing information, preserve separate track policies, and do not start research without an explicit choice.
messages.agentPrompt.boundPrompt: Use the installed Career Agent workspace associated with workspace ID {workspace_id}. Before working, resolve this exact descriptor with the installed CLI: {descriptor}. {action} Copying this prompt does not execute it, grant permission, or authorize sending.
messages.agentPrompt.researchInstruction: Find useful evidenced people and opportunities within the selected tracks. Reuse existing permission only for its exact unchanged scope. Ask only if an actual start or scope choice is missing. Stop new research immediately when paused.
messages.agentPrompt.prepareInstruction: Prepare or revise the exact selected case packet from supported evidence. Review facts and tone, preserve meaningful achievements, and save immutable documents through the installed task facade. Do not send anything or accept agreements. Choose a supported argument for this reader; inspect claim_frontier and use separate factual/editorial review.
messages.agentPrompt.reviewInstruction: Read the actual selected saved bytes and review them against source evidence, disclosure choices, contact facts and tone. Report concrete findings and save through the installed task facade. Do not treat a copied prompt or a self-certified checklist as proof of review. Review actual argument/evidence/voice, not field presence. Bind the judgment to exact content and scope; do not send.
